summary: A physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba with no samples: each note is computed from a model of hammer and tine or mallet and bar. The same instrument also runs on the Ableton Move and as a desktop plugin.
features: Four electric pianos, a vibraphone with motor, and a marimba
Compressor, EQ, drive, filter, tremolo, phaser, chorus, delay, reverb
Velocity from the FM-1 keys, sustain, chords, scales, arpeggiator
Pattern recorder of 1-16 bars with overdub and per-step chance
USB and TRS MIDI, clock, USB audio; 19 factory, 16 user presets
10 voices, or 14 with the two-core package

headings: on your computer: the desktop plugin
